primary.primary_endpoint: exact normalized CDS-chain gene-locus agreement to complete RefSeq; all domain-contained prediction CDS chains enter the denominator and start/stop completeness is stratified

long_read.boundary: BRAKER UTR-off CDS intron chains are compared to observed transcript intron chains; UTR introns can prevent equality. RefSeq-CDS-compatible subset is explicitly reference-assisted, not independent CDS endpoint truth.
long_read.interpretation: positive-only structural recovery; no precision/FP derived from unobserved RNA; source class u may include noncoding transcripts
